Daily Devotional

May 16

13 Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men. (Matthew 5:13 KJV)

The Greek word “MORAINO” that was translated “lost…savour” in this verse, was translated as “became fools” in Romans (Romans 1:22), and is the Greek word that we get our word moron from. What this is saying is that if we are not acting as salt to the world around us, then we are acting like fools or morons. God has no other way to salt the earth except through us Christians, as He must flow through us (Ephesians 3:20), so we need to be preserving the earth and all its inhabitants every day, in every way.

The fool has said that there is no God (Psalms 14:1 & 53:1), so it is up to the Church to get out and salt the world for Christ, and save as many as can be saved, to the Glory of God. It is an awesome responsibility to have been given the job of carrying the Gospel of Jesus Christ to the entire world (Mark 16:15), and every Christian should study the Word of God continually, and share the Gospel to every one they have contact with. If we don’t save them, who will? Praise God for His goodness.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
